newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dickson details plans on Kenneth Cole.
newsitem.headline: Dickson details plans on Kenneth Cole.

text.p: Hong Kong-based upmarket retailer Dickson Concepts (International) Ltd said on Monday it planned to have 10 Kenneth Cole Production Inc stores in place in Southeast Asia within a year.

It would open Kenneth Cole retail outlets in major Southeast Asian cities including Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore and Malaysia in the fiscal year ending March 31, 1998, Dickson's chairman, Dickson Poon, told a news conference.
But he would not disclose the investment figure.
"We estimate that they (the stores) will more than break even in the first year of operation," Poon said.
The company had secured the retail and wholesale rights for all Kenneth Cole products in Southeast Asia in a "long-term" agreement, Poon said.
Kenneth Cole makes leather shoes and bags, he said.
